## featurelifted/__init__.py:2
"""
featurelifted: signature-preserving function decorators.

A task-scoped extraction of the core ``decorate`` / ``decorator``
functionality from the well-known ``decorator`` package (BSD-2-Clause,
Copyright (c) 2005-2021, Michele Simionato).

A "caller" is a function of the form ``def caller(f, *args, **kw)`` that
receives the original (undecorated) function followed by the arguments of
the decorated call.  ``decorator`` turns such a caller into a
signature-preserving decorator (or a factory of decorators, when the
caller declares parameters with default values).  The decorated functions
keep name, docstring, module, annotations, ``__wrapped__`` and the
original ``inspect.signature``.
"""
import inspect
from inspect import iscoroutinefunction, isgeneratorfunction

__version__ = '5.1.1'
